materials.name: S1000-2
materials.peel_condition: after solder float (288 C, 10 s), 1 oz EDC foil

thickness_range.steps_note: The Shengyi sheet writes 0.002"-0.125" with (0.5 mm to 3.2 mm); the purchasing table of the catalogue sheet gives 0.05 mm to 3.2 mm.

lamination.notes: Heat-up 1.0-2.5 C/min while the material is at 80-140 C; full pressure 300-420 PSI (oil heated) applied when the top layer is at 80-100 C; cure 180-190 C for more than 45 min; 8-10 layers per opening.

drilling.retract_notes: Harder than traditional FR-4: reduce the chip load by 10-20 % and decrease the hit count.

processing.desmear_note: Filled resin system, harder to desmear than traditional FR-4: strengthen the desmear and use ultrasonic rinse; baking 150 C for 4 h after drilling helps.
processing.bake_note: Thin cores 150 C for 4-8 h; before HAL 150 C for 2-4 h if measling is seen; finished boards 125 C for 4-6 h before packaging.

materials.notes: Typical values are for the 1.6 mm (8 x 7628) specimen. Dk and Df are published at 1 MHz only. The sheet gives T260/T288/T300 as 60/20/5 min. CTI class PLC 3 (175-249 V). Dielectric breakdown 45 kV or 63 kV (kV, not per mm) is not stored.

materials.name: S1000-2B

lamination.notes: Heat-up 1.0-2.5 C/min between 80 and 140 C; cure more than 60 min at 185-195 C. The pressing chart of the sheet peaks at 200 C and 350 PSI; its values are for reference only.

materials.notes: Bonding prepreg for S1000-2; cured thickness is the column of the sheet. Dk and Df tested to IPC-TM-650 2.5.5.9 at 1 GHz. materials.notes: Passive intermodulation -163 dBc. Volume resistivity is published in ohm mm and is not stored. Tensile values: filling is crosswise and warp is lengthwise. CTE directions X, Y, Z (the Z value is stored as below Tg). Dk tolerance 0.02.
